name: @veda-hq/sarathi
description: Runs a project's Claude Code hooks from one entry per event, with kavach's guards built in, and carries the sarathi plugin's agents and working-rules skill.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf lessons && cp -R ../../docs/lessons lessons
scripts.smoke: node dist/bin.js --version && node dist/bin.js check --config test/fixture/sarathi.json --settings test/fixture/settings.json && echo {} | bash hooks/format-before-write.sh && SARATHI_LESSONS_DIR=$(mktemp -d) bash hooks/lessons.sh < test/fixture/pools-failure.json | grep -q 'Address pools exhausted'
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
